title: Database Browser
subtitle: Browse cached and server files (SHT, MC h5, Master H5, CIF, XTAL)

tabs.shtTip: Spherical Harmonic Transform master files for spherical indexing
tabs.masterTip: Master-pattern HDF5 files for dictionary indexing (…_master_…_npx….h5)
tabs.cifTip: Crystallographic Information Files — crystal structure definitions
tabs.xtalTip: EMsoft crystal structure files — converted from CIF for simulation
tabs.dictTip: Dictionary index .h5 files (derived from masters). Kept separate and excluded from bulk upload by default.

controls.offlineModeTooltip: Stop the 5-second auto-refresh and avoid contacting the server (work from local files only).
controls.refreshTooltip: Reload the file list and cache statistics from the local library and server now.
controls.syncAllTooltip: Bidirectional sync: download server files to local cache AND upload local files to server
controls.uploadAllTooltip: Open the upload dialog: choose which categories (SHT, MC h5, Master, CIF, XTAL) to push to the server, with a progress bar.
controls.downloadAllTooltip: Open the download dialog: choose which categories (SHT, Master, CIF, XTAL, …) to pull from the server into your local cache, with a progress bar.
controls.uploadSelectedTooltip: Copy the selected local files (any type — SHT, MC h5, Master, CIF, XTAL) to the server. Differing server copies are kept unless you confirm overwrite.
controls.deleteSelectedTooltip: Delete selected files with cascade dependency resolution

filter.searchTooltip: Filter the table to files whose name contains this text.
filter.typeTooltip: Restrict the table to one file format within this tab.
filter.materialTooltip: Show only files of the chosen material or element.

table.rowSelectTooltip: Select this file for Upload to server or Delete Selected.
table.rowClickTooltip: Select this file to show its preview and details in the panel on the right.
table.colLocationTooltip: Where the file is stored: local, server, or both
table.colMaterialTooltip: Material / element extracted from filename or metadata
table.colTypeTooltip: File format: SHT, H5, CIF, or XTAL
table.emptyHint: Check your network connection or adjust the filter criteria.
table.downloadTooltip: Download this server file into the local library.
table.openTooltip: Open this file (HDF5 → viewer; CIF/XTAL → structure preview).

preview.title: Preview
preview.emptyHint: Click a row in the table
preview.thumbSelectLocal: Select a local file to preview
preview.openInHdf5ViewerTooltip: Open the selected MC or master HDF5 file in the in-app HDF5 viewer.

shtInfo.parametersToggleTooltip: Show or hide the SHT simulation parameters (dmin, npx, voltage, tilt, bandwidth).

sphere.resolutionTooltip: Choose sphere reconstruction quality: Standard, High, or Max bandwidth/grid.
sphere.downloadFirst: Download this file first to view its sphere.
sphere.selectLocal: Select a local .sht to view its sphere.
sphere.hint: drag to rotate · scroll to zoom
sphere.captureNotReady: The sphere is not ready yet — wait until it is drawn.

splitterTooltip: Drag to resize the file table versus the preview panel.

status.uploadNothingLocal: Nothing to upload — none of the selected files exist locally.
status.cacheClearDisabled: Bulk cache-clear is disabled to protect your CIF/XTAL library (the cache dirs ARE the library). Select files and use Delete to remove local copies.
status.dismissTooltip: Dismiss the current status or sync message.

cache.refreshStatsTooltip: Refreshes cache stats. Bulk delete is disabled to protect your library — remove local copies via file selection + Delete.

cascade.associatedTooltip: Include or exclude this dependent file when deleting; required files cannot be unchecked.
cascade.scopeTooltip: Confirm deletion scope: local copies only, server copies only, or both.
cascade.cancelTooltip: Close the delete dialog without removing any files.

upload.overwriteMessage: {{count}} selected file(s) already exist on the server with different content. Overwrite the server copy with your local version?

syncUpload.title: Upload to server
syncUpload.subtitle: Choose which categories to push to the server. Each row shows how many local files would be sent (and how many already exist on the server).
syncUpload.nothingInCategory: No local files in this category
syncUpload.overwrite: Overwrite files that already exist on the server with a different version

syncDownload.title: Download from server
syncDownload.subtitle: Choose which categories to pull from the server into your local cache. Each row shows how many server files would be downloaded (and how many you already have locally).
syncDownload.nothingInCategory: No server files in this category
syncDownload.overwrite: Overwrite local files that already exist with a different version

crystalStructure.downloadFirst: Download this file first to view its structure.
crystalStructure.hint: Drag to rotate · scroll to zoom · hover an atom for details · click a legend entry to hide an element
crystalStructure.polyhedraTooltip: Show/hide coordination polyhedra around the minority atoms
crystalStructure.screenshotTooltip: Export the view as a PNG image
